provenance: Each takhrīj encoder's output typed by Usul.Judgement: the sort, and for a judgement the Question or Aspect it answers. Classified from each encoder's Lean definition, docstring and qāʿida (LLM-assisted, adjudicated); not human-reviewed. `alt` records the second reading of a hard case; `negated` marks an encoder whose true is the question's no.

abstention_under_possible_condition.question: aspect:obligatory
abstention_under_possible_condition.reason: abstains (Ibn Rajab 160 'يعتزل امرأته حتى يعلم انتفاؤه'): 'abstention governs conduct, not status'; whether he must abstain.

advance_after_cause.question: aspect:permitted
advance_after_cause.reason: Qaida 4: «لا يجوز تقديمها على سبب وجوبها ويجوز تقديمها بعد سبب الوجوب» - may he advance it.
advance_after_cause.alt: wadi:validity: in worship «لا يجوز» here also means the advanced act does not count

advanced_kaffara_at_obligation.question: wadi:validity
advanced_kaffara_at_obligation.reason: Qāʿida 5: advancedSufficesIn - whether an act (kaffāra) advanced before its time suffices (ijzāʾ), «فبرئ به»; true = it counts.

advanced_worship.question: wadi:validity
advanced_worship.reason: Qaida 5: the advanced act suffices («فبرئ به») when it was the duty at performance - ijza'.

alternative_proven_alone.reason: q111 «فقامت حجة بها أحدهما دون الآخر فهل يثبت»: alternativeProvenAlone - whether a proof establishing only one alternative suffices to establish it (owed only if the proof establishes the cause).
alternative_proven_alone.alt: wadi:sabab: output phrased as whether the alternative is owed

amr.reason: amrStatus returns the Hukm of the commanded act; the qarīna-dependent wording is the means, the answer is the act's taklīfī status.
amr.question: taklifi

amr_mixed.reason: amrPerItem returns each commanded item's Hukm: the taklīfī status of each act.
amr_mixed.question: taklifi

annulment_on_nonexistent.question: wadi:validity
annulment_on_nonexistent.reason: Qaida 59: «الفسوخ فترد على المعدوم» - whether an annulment on what no longer exists takes effect.
annulment_on_nonexistent.alt: wadi:sabab: whether the annulment is a sabab of its effects

annulment_without_return.question: wadi:validity
annulment_without_return.reason: Qaida 59 with the defect farq: no return for a perished defective thing («وسقط الرد لتعذره») - whether the annulment takes effect.

aqila_bears_across_change.reason: Q129 farʿ: who bears the diya, this ʿāqila or the shooter's own wealth — to whom the liability goes.
aqila_bears_across_change.alt: judgement wadi:sabab: read as 'is this ʿāqila liable?'

asl_zahir.reason: zahirPrevails: 'the ẓāhir prevails when strictly stronger, or equal and the matter has indicators' over Grades; which presumption establishes the fact.

attached_growth_follows.reason: Q81: whether attached growth follows the aʿyān on reversion and in security/liability — treating growth as part of the substance.
attached_growth_follows.alt: effect: to whom the growth goes on reversion

attached_right_disposal.question: wadi:validity
attached_right_disposal.reason: Q53: whether the disposal of a thing to which a right attaches takes effect («لم ينفذ» / «صح التصرف»).

attached_takeover_at_value.question: wadi:sabab
attached_takeover_at_value.reason: Q77: whether the principal's owner gains the right to take over the subordinate at its value and its owner is compelled — a right arising.
attached_takeover_at_value.alt: effect: who ends up owning the attached thing

ayman_by_urf.reason: oathBody (Ibn Rajab 1.f003, Q9 'والأيمان مرجعها إلى العرف'): what the oath's wording names, measured by custom.
ayman_by_urf.alt: takyif (custom counts the river as one body)

badal_stands_for_original.reason: Q143 «يقوم البدل مقام المبدل ويسد مسده ويبني حكمه على حكم مبدله»: badalStands - whether the substitute is treated as the original so its ruling builds on the original's; a characterisation of the substitute.
badal_stands_for_original.alt: judgement wadi:sabab: whether the original's right/ruling passes to the substitute (cf. right_to_substitute)

bain_in_idda_as_wife.reason: Q145 «المعتدة البائن في حكم الزوجات في مسائل»: bainAsWife - whether she is treated as a wife while the ties of marriage remain.

benefit_condition_against_compensation.question: wadi:validity
benefit_condition_against_compensation.reason: Q73: a stipulated benefit against compensation «فيصح», otherwise «فلا يصح».

benefit_exception.question: wadi:validity
benefit_exception.reason: Qaida 32: «يصح عندنا استثناء منفعة العين» for a known period (or where uncertainty is tolerated); output is validity of the exception.

benefit_then_thing.question: wadi:sabab
benefit_then_thing.reason: Qaida 35: whether owning the thing dissolves (ينفسخ) a prior contract on its benefit - acquisition as sabab of dissolution.
benefit_then_thing.alt: wadi:validity: whether the prior contract stays in force

benefit_to_other.question: wadi:sabab
benefit_to_other.reason: liableForOthersBenefit (Ibn Rajab 27 'وإن كان النفع يعود إلى غيره فعليه الضمان'): whether the destruction is a sabab of ḍamān.

budh_capacity_is_wealth.reason: Q131: whether capacity to earn by the buḍʿ counts as ghinā — classification of the person as rich.

burdened_thing_compensated.question: wadi:sabab
burdened_thing_compensated.reason: Q138 «وجب ضمانها بالتلف والإتلاف ... ووجب بالإتلاف إن كان مستحق موجود»: mustCompensate - whether loss or destruction is a sabab of ḍamān.

cancel_on_existence_valid.question: wadi:validity
cancel_on_existence_valid.reason: q118 «إن كان فيه مقصود معتبر شرعا صح وإلا لم يصح»: cancelOnExistenceValid - 'The output is that the suspension is valid'.

cause_from_one_of_two.reason: Qaida 14 returns Attach neither/each/lot/abstain: to whom the ruling attaches when the cause is from one of two unknown - an allocation enum.
cause_from_one_of_two.alt: epistemic: arises from doubt over which of two

cause_on_certainty.reason: Concordance.attachOnCertainty returns Attach (neither/each/lot/abstain): to whom the ruling of a cause from one of two men attaches (qāʿida 14).
cause_on_certainty.alt: epistemic: the qāʿida is about doubt over which man the cause came from, each certain of his own state

cause_restricts_general.reason: q124 «هل نخص اللفظ العام بسببه الخاص»: causeRestricts - whether a general word is restricted to its prompting cause.

combination_bars_its_amount.question: wadi:mani
combination_bars_its_amount.reason: q109 second kind «والمنع من الجمع يمنع من التصرف في القدر الذي يحصل به الجمع»: whether the combining amount is barred from disposal.

combining_forms.question: aspect:permitted
combining_forms.reason: Qaida 12: forms that are substitutes are not combined, others may be («جمعت فعله وأمره») - may he combine.
combining_forms.alt: wadi:validity: Taqi al-Din «ولا يصح الجمع بين البدل والمبدل»

command_intended_usage.reason: CommandSchemata.intendedUsage returns CommandUsage: whether a command intending recommendation or permission is literal or figurative (43.f007); the intended ruling is an input.

command_nonverbal_usage.reason: CommandSchemata.nonverbalUsage returns CommandUsage (literal/notLiteral/unsettled): whether writing or gesture is literally named a command; the module says naming is distinct from assigning a ruling.

command_obligation_status.question: taklifi
command_obligation_status.reason: CommandSchemata.obligationStatus returns a Hukm: the five-fold status of the act commanded by an unqualified threat / wujūb / farḍ label, under a reading and qarīna (43.f004).
command_obligation_status.alt: dalala: the issue is whether explicit obligation expressions are naṣṣ immune to reinterpretation

command_prophetic_act_usage.reason: CommandSchemata.propheticActUsage returns CommandUsage: whether the Prophet's act is literally or figuratively called amr (43.f002).

common_amount_general.reason: q109 third kind «والمنع من القدر المشترك كالمنع من الجميع يقتضي العموم»: whether a bar on the common amount (indefinite under negation) is general over every instance - generality of wording.

concurrent_causes.reason: concurrentShare returns full/half (Ibn Rajab 28): the non-permitted actor's share of liability.

concurrent_condition.question: wadi:shart
concurrent_condition.reason: Qaida 56: the condition of capacity suffices when concurrent with the contract - is the condition met.

continued_holding.question: wadi:sabab
continued_holding.reason: Qaida 43: continued holding makes liable only one who withholds («فهو غاصب») - liability (daman) as effect of a sabab.

continuity.reason: continuous: 'consecutive parts lie within the customary gap' (Q48 / Ibn Rajab 103 'الفعل الواحد يبنى بعضه على بعض مع الاتصال المعتاد'): whether the parts count as one continuous act, a characterisation by custom.
continuity.alt: judgement wadi:shart (muwālāh as a condition met), but the def classifies the fact, not the condition

contract_by_kinaya.question: wadi:validity
contract_by_kinaya.reason: Qāʿida 39: kinayaConcludes - whether a contract concludes (inʿiqād) by allusive wording, barred for nikāḥ which needs witnessing.
contract_by_kinaya.alt: dalala: what allusive wording can effect

craft_capacity_is_wealth.reason: Q132 «القدرة على اكتساب المال بالصناعات غني»: craftCountsAsRich - whether the craftsman counts as rich (ghinā), as budh_capacity_is_wealth.
craft_capacity_is_wealth.alt: judgement wadi:mani: richness as a bar to zakāt/maintenance entitlement, or a shart of ḥajj

crop_without_valid_permission.question: wadi:sabab
crop_without_valid_permission.reason: Q79: absence of valid permission is «المقتضي لتملك الزرع» — whether the landowner's right to take the crop arises.
crop_without_valid_permission.alt: judgement aspect:permitted: 'the landowner may take the crop'

custodian_liable_at_due_time.reason: Q141 «لزمه ضمانها بقيمتها في ذلك الوقت، لا يوم تلفها»: dueTimeGoverns - at which moment (term vs day of destruction) the ḍamān is reckoned, i.e. how much, as hit_state_governs.
custodian_liable_at_due_time.alt: judgement wadi:sabab: read as whether he is liable at all; but liability is presupposed and only its measure varies

custom_restricts_general.reason: q122 «يخص العموم بالعادة»: customRestricts - whether the general term is restricted by custom.

cut_sale_left_to_ripen.question: wadi:validity
cut_sale_left_to_ripen.reason: Q81 farʿ: «فهل يبطل البيع» — validity of the sale; NOTE polarity inverted: true = the sale is void (fāsid).
cut_sale_left_to_ripen.alt: judgement wadi:mani: leaving until ripe as an impediment annulling the sale

daman_without_qabd.question: wadi:sabab
daman_without_qabd.reason: Qaida 51: what is determined enters the new owner's daman without transport - liability arising.

defective_compensation.reason: Q47 returns CompensationBasis agreed/equivalent: how much is owed under daman (named consideration vs equivalent).

delegating_work.question: aspect:permitted
delegating_work.reason: q69 «فلا يجوز للمعقود معه أن يقيم غيره مقامه»: mayDelegate - whether the one engaged for work may delegate it.
delegating_work.alt: wadi:validity: whether the delegation is effective under the contract

deputy_of_principal.question: wadi:sabab
deputy_of_principal.reason: Qāʿida 61 docstring: 'a deputy is removed with his principal's removal or death unless his mandate is general' - asks whether the principal's removal/death is a sabab of the deputy's authority lapsing.

deputy_of_qadi.question: wadi:sabab
deputy_of_qadi.reason: Qāʿida 61 with the madhhab: the qāḍī's deputies are 'removed with him even under a general mandate' - same question, whether the principal's removal is a sabab of the deputy's removal.

desisting_at_once.reason: Qaida 58: desisting at once «is not doing the forbidden» unless he foresaw it - whether the desisting counts as the forbidden act.
desisting_at_once.alt: judgement aspect:permitted (negated): whether he sins by it

disposal_before_qabd.question: aspect:permitted
disposal_before_qabd.reason: Qaida 52: «ولا منع من التصرف إلا في المبهم» - may he dispose before qabd.
disposal_before_qabd.alt: wadi:validity: whether the disposal is valid/effective («لا تملك بدون القبض»)

disposal_before_qabd_debt.question: aspect:permitted
disposal_before_qabd_debt.reason: Qaida 52 with the bar on selling a debt to a third party («ولا يجوز لغيره») - may he dispose.
disposal_before_qabd_debt.alt: wadi:validity: whether the sale of the debt is valid

disposal_over_anothers_right.question: aspect:permitted
disposal_over_anothers_right.reason: Qaida 54: one may not dispose so as to extinguish another's right («والصحيح أنه لا يجوز») - may he dispose.
disposal_over_anothers_right.alt: wadi:validity: whether such disposal is valid

dispose_without_judge.question: aspect:permitted
dispose_without_judge.reason: Q97: «فليس له التصرف فيه بدون إذن الحاكم» / «جاز التصدق به» — whether he may give it in charity without the judge.

distribution_each_over_whole.reason: q113: eachOverWhole - whether a numbered set distributed over another is read each-over-whole or one-to-one, by qarīna of custom or sharʿ - interpretation of the wording.

double_kinship_preferred.reason: q120 «يرجح ذو القرابتين على ذي القرابة الواحدة»: doubleKinshipPreferred - who is preferred in the entitlement (to whom it goes).

doubled.reason: compensationOwed returns a Nat amount (Q35 'ضوعف عليه الضمان'): how much ḍamān is owed, not yes/no.

doubt_in_condition.question: wadi:validity
doubt_in_condition.reason: validUnderDoubt (Ibn Rajab 68 'فلا يصح إيقاعه بهذا التردد... فالصحيح فيه الصحة'): whether the act done while doubting a condition is valid.

each_on_its_asl.reason: Qaida 15: a presumption's corollary that would alter another asl is ignored, each matter stays on its own asl - which presumption establishes the fact.

eating_without_permission.question: aspect:permitted
eating_without_permission.reason: q71 «فيجوز الأكل منه»: mayEat - whether he may eat from property without its owner's permission.

entitlement_multiplies.reason: q119 second attached qāʿida «فهل يتعدد الاستحقاق بها»: entitlementMultiplies - whether entitlement is multiplied by combined attributes (how much he takes).
entitlement_multiplies.alt: wadi:sabab: whether each attribute is a separate sabab of entitlement

error_actor_liable.question: wadi:sabab
error_actor_liable.reason: Q95: output is the liability of one who destroys/disposes in mistaken belief.

excess_in_following.question: aspect:obligatory
excess_in_following.reason: Qāʿida 3 «هل يوصف الكل بالوجوب أو قدر الإجزاء منه»: excessObligatoryIn says whether the undistinguished excess is described as obligatory; the following-farq is a further input.
excess_in_following.alt: wadi:validity: the following-farq is about the excess counting (إدراك الركعة) for the one who joins

excess_over_sufficient.question: aspect:obligatory
excess_over_sufficient.reason: Qaida 3: «هل يوصف الكل بالوجوب أو قدر الإجزاء منه» - whether the undistinguished excess bears the status wajib or is nafl.
excess_over_sufficient.alt: takyif: classifying the performed excess as fard vs tatawwu' rather than asking whether he must do it

excused_error.question: wadi:validity
excused_error.reason: errorExcused: 'the act stands despite the error, unless another's right is attached or he was negligent' (Ibn Rajab 6 'فإنه يجزئه').

failed_obligation_returns.question: wadi:sabab
failed_obligation_returns.reason: Qaida 30: «فهل يعود إلى ملكه» what was given as due and failed to count - ownership reverting.

fay_tie_break.reason: fayTieBreak returns byCriteria/rulerChoice (Ibn Rajab 160.f038): how equal fayʾ recipients are ordered.

follows_proven_ownership.question: wadi:sabab
follows_proven_ownership.reason: Qaida 25: whether what is attached to or born of an owned thing proven by bayyina/iqrar follows it into his ownership - ownership arising.
follows_proven_ownership.alt: takyif: turns on whether the accessory counts as part of the thing (what follows in sale)

forbidden_cause_voided.question: wadi:mani
forbidden_cause_voided.reason: Q102: a cause brought about in a forbidden way that souls are drawn to is cancelled «ولم يترتب عليه أحكامه» — the forbidden manner bars the cause's effect.
forbidden_cause_voided.alt: judgement wadi:validity with inverted polarity (true = effects do not follow)

forced_acquisition.question: wadi:sabab
forced_acquisition.reason: Qaida 50: a forced acquisition is owned before payment only under necessity - ownership arising.

forced_acquisition_solvent.question: wadi:sabab
forced_acquisition_solvent.reason: Qaida 50 with the shuf'a farq: the solvent shafi' owns by the demand - ownership arising.

free_bestowal_of_needed_ayn.question: aspect:obligatory
free_bestowal_of_needed_ayn.reason: Q99: a needed, harmless thing «يجب بذله مجانا» — must he give it free?

free_bestowal_of_needed_benefit.question: aspect:obligatory
free_bestowal_of_needed_benefit.reason: Q99: a needed benefit «يجب بذله مجانا» — must he give it free?

generality.reason: IsGeneralIn (Q59/Q60): whether a noun form in a context is a marker of generality, blocked by ʿahd.

ghulul_forfeiture.question: wadi:sabab
ghulul_forfeiture.reason: ghululForfeits: 'whether the share is forfeited' (Ibn Rajab 140.f006 'حرمان سهمه'); ghulūl as a sabab of the right lapsing.

growth_from_substance.reason: Qawaid 20-21: growth from the substance «حكمه حكم الجزء»; classifies the growth as part or separate.

hair_detached.reason: Qaida 2: «شعر الحيوان في حكم المنفصل عنه لا في حكم المتصل» classifies hair/nails as attached or detached.

haml_ala_adna.reason: hamlAlaAdna: 'an unspecified intention over referents that differ in rank is read as the lowest' (Ibn al-Laḥḥām 52.f008); what an utterance/intention covers.

hand_liability.question: wadi:sabab
hand_liability.reason: handLiable (Ibn Rajab 91 'يضمن بالعقد وباليد الأموال المحضة... فيضمن باليد'): whether the hand is a sabab of ḍamān over the thing.
hand_liability.alt: takyif (the input classifies the thing as property-like)

hand_with_owner_liable.question: wadi:sabab
hand_with_owner_liable.reason: Q92: whether a hand of liability stands with the owner's hand; output is liability.

handover_by_description.reason: Q98: «من ادعى شيئا ووصفه دفع إليه بالصفة» — whether a claimant's description suffices to have the thing handed to him, a matter of claim and proof.
handover_by_description.alt: effect: to whom the thing is handed

hastened_right_forfeited.question: wadi:mani
hastened_right_forfeited.reason: Q102 attached qāʿida: «من تعجل حقه ... على وجه محرم عوقب بحرمانه» — forbidden hastening bars the right (e.g. killing the muwarrith).

heir_stands_in_owed_right.question: wadi:sabab
heir_stands_in_owed_right.reason: Q144 second kind «فإذا كانت لازمة قام الوارث مقامه»: heirStandsIn - whether death passes the deceased's binding (or tending-to-bind) obligation to the heir rather than its lapsing.
heir_stands_in_owed_right.alt: wadi:validity: whether the contract survives death («فلا يبطل في الموت») or lapses

heir_takes_deceased_right.question: wadi:sabab
heir_takes_deceased_right.reason: Q144 first kind «ثبت لهم إرثه» / «فينتقل إلى الورثة»: heirInherits - whether the deceased's right passes to the heirs (a right arising for them).
heir_takes_deceased_right.alt: effect: to whom the right goes (heirs vs lapsing)

hit_state_governs.reason: Q129: which moment (hit vs shot) the liability is reckoned at; output selects the reference state, an allocation, not a yes/no ruling.
hit_state_governs.alt: takyif: characterising which state of the target counts

holding_after_contract_end.question: wadi:sabab
holding_after_contract_end.reason: Qaida 43 second division: liable where he caused the ending («لأنه يسبب») - liability as effect of a sabab.

hukm_against_own_ijtihad.reason: rulingUndone: a judge's ruling is 'undone only when a clear text shows it wrong' (Ibn Rajab 68.f009 'ولم ينقض حكمه').

ihram_specification.question: wadi:validity
ihram_specification.reason: validOnEvery: 'what suffices under a forgotten intention: what is valid on every possibility' (Ibn Rajab 106.f007 'لا يجزئه').

implicit_exception.question: wadi:validity
implicit_exception.reason: Qaida 33 docstring: an exception of uncertain extent is valid when it arises by law (al-Mughni «الصحة»).

injury_state_measures.reason: Q128 first qism: guaranteed in both states but the amount differs; output picks the state by which the ḍamān is measured (how much), not whether it is owed.
injury_state_measures.alt: judgement wadi:sabab: Bool is false outside the first qism, where no ḍamān is owed in both states

intention_shapes_wording.reason: Q125: whether the intention generalises, specifies, restricts or excepts from the wording, i.e. the scope of the utterance.

istihlak.reason: istihlak (Ibn Rajab 22 'العين المنغمرة في غيرها... هل هي كالمعدومة حكما'): whether the consumed substance counts as non-existent.
istihlak.alt: epistemic (defined as an instance of treatedAsAbsent)

itlaf.question: wadi:sabab
itlaf.reason: itlafLiable: 'destruction without right is compensable, whatever the mental state' (Q13/Q36); asks whether the destruction is a sabab of ḍamān.

khalt_as_shirka.reason: mixedOutcome returns shared/consumed/separate (Ibn Rajab 22.f003 'أنه اشتراك'): the ownership outcome of mixing.

knowledge.question: wadi:shart
knowledge.reason: Requirement.normalize (Q45 / Ibn Rajab 63 'من لا يعتبر رضاه لفسخ عقد أو حله لا يعتبر علمه به'): whether the party's knowledge is a condition of the contract or rescission.
knowledge.alt: wadi:validity (the rescission is valid without his knowledge), but the output field is the requirement itself

lease_after_authority.question: wadi:sabab
lease_after_authority.reason: Qaida 36: a lease dissolves when the lessor's authority ends unless the new holder succeeds him - end of authority as sabab of dissolution.
lease_after_authority.alt: wadi:validity: whether the lease remains in force

lot_distinguishes_hidden_entitled.reason: Q105 furūʿ: an entitled one unknown to us «فيميز بالقرعة» — the qurʿa as the means of determining the entitled party.
lot_distinguishes_hidden_entitled.alt: epistemic: lot resolves our ignorance of a fact

lots.reason: allocationFull returns toEntitled/divide/lot (Q25 / Ibn Rajab 160): which allocation applies.

luqata.reason: luqata returns hold/finderOwns/charity (Ibn Rajab 106.f002): the outcome of a found item.

maadum_grant_valid.question: wadi:validity
maadum_grant_valid.reason: Q107: grant to the non-existent «فالمشهور أنه لا يصح» / «فيصح في الوقف» — whether the grant holds.

makeup_after_failure.reason: Q31 returns MakeupExtent asBegun/baseline: the form of a subsequent make-up, not whether one is owed; an outcome enum.

manumission_spread.question: wadi:sabab
manumission_spread.reason: Qaida 34: whether manumission's effect spreads (سريان العتق) to benefits owed under a binding contract - the reach of a sabab's effect.
manumission_spread.alt: wadi:mani: the source phrases the binding contract as «يمنع من سريان العتق», output is the negation of the bar

many_over_noble.reason: preferMany (Ibn Rajab 17 'فأيهما يرجح... ترجيح الكثرة'): which of two equal-cost acts counts as the more meritorious; a ranking of merit not expressible as a Hukm or Aspect.
many_over_noble.alt: judgement taklifi (afḍaliyya within the mandūb), but no Question/Aspect answers a preference

mistaken_basis.question: wadi:validity
mistaken_basis.reason: validWithBasis: 'valid when he acted on a basis he believed and a valid basis in fact existed' (Ibn Rajab 66 'التصرف صحيح').

mixed_haram_by_proportion.reason: mixedHaram returns suspend/takeOut (Ibn Rajab 22.f007 'وجب التوقف... يخرج منها درهما'): which course applies to the mixed wealth.
mixed_haram_by_proportion.alt: judgement taklifi/aspect:obligatory (each option is a duty of conduct), but the answer is an enum

mubashara_tasabbub.reason: Mubashara.damanOn returns Daman (mubashir/sabab/shared): on whom the ḍamān of an itlāf falls (q127).

nafaqa_stipulated_in_contract.question: wadi:validity
nafaqa_stipulated_in_contract.reason: Q72: whether a stipulation of maintenance/clothing holds (is valid) in the contract, as muʿāwaḍa only in binding contracts.

nafaqa_taken_owned.question: wadi:sabab
nafaqa_taken_owned.reason: Q72: whether the worker owns the maintenance (يملك فيها الطعام والكسوة) — ownership arising.

nafl_before_fard.question: wadi:validity

necessity_spares_lighter.question: aspect:permitted
necessity_spares_lighter.reason: q112: necessityPermits - 'whether the option is permitted to him' when two forbidden things meet in necessity («فلا يباح»).

needed_item_is_surplus.reason: Q130: whether a needed house/servant/mount counts as surplus wealth (mal fāḍil) — classification of the item.

occurrence_state_governs.reason: q117 «فهل يغلب عليه جانب التعليق أو جانب الوقوع»: occurrenceGoverns - which state a suspended contract is characterised by (Bool encodes a binary choice), not a ruling.

other_option_stands.question: wadi:sabab
other_option_stands.reason: Q110: «فإن اختار أحدهما سقط الآخر» — whether the other right survives (a right lapsing).

partial_capability.question: aspect:obligatory
partial_capability.reason: obligedParts (Q40 / Ibn Rajab 8 'هل يلزمه الإتيان بما قدر عليه'): whether he must do the part he can.

partners.question: aspect:obligatory
partners.reason: partnerMustJoin: 'a refusing co-owner is compelled to what the common holding necessarily requires' (Q30 / Ibn Rajab 76 'أجبر أحدهما على موافقة الآخر'): must he join.

performed_without_leave_not_owned.question: wadi:validity

performed_without_leave_owned.question: wadi:validity
performed_without_leave_owned.reason: Q96 first kind: true when the performance «وقع الموقع» / «يجزئ» with no liability — the discharge counts.

prevention_easier_than_removal.question: wadi:mani

prohibited_worship.question: wadi:validity
prohibited_worship.reason: Qaida 9: worship in a prohibited way «لم يصح» unless the prohibition returns to what is no condition - sihha.

qabd_in_contracts.question: wadi:sabab

qawad_choice_forfeits_attached_right.question: wadi:sabab

qisas_belongs_to_whom.question: wadi:validity

recourse.question: wadi:sabab

recourse_after_return.question: wadi:sabab
recourse_after_return.reason: q67 «فهل يستحق الرجوع ببدله»: recourseAfterReturn - whether a right of recourse for the substitute arises when the thing came back by gift.

refusal_compelled_to_choose.question: aspect:obligatory
refusal_compelled_to_choose.reason: Q110: «وإن كان الحق غير مالي ألزم بالاختيار» — he must choose.

refusal_exacted_for_him.reason: Q110: on refusing both, «استوفى له الحق الأصلي» — one branch of an outcome enum (exacted / falls / compelled to choose).

refusal_right_falls.question: wadi:sabab
refusal_right_falls.reason: Q110: «وإن لم يكن حقا ثابتا سقط» — whether his right lapses.

removal_before_knowledge.question: wadi:sabab

repeat_bearing_roots_as_trees.reason: Q80: whether repeatedly bearing roots are attached to crops or to trees — classification.

rescission_harm.reason: RajabA1.rescission returns Rescission (barred/withRemedy/free): what a harmful rescission of a non-binding contract does (q60, «لم يجز ولم ينفذ إلا أن يمكن استدراك الضرر»).

rescue_loss_liability.question: wadi:sabab
rescue_loss_liability.reason: Q78: whether one who brings loss on another's property to free his own is liable (ḍamān).

return_of_held_property.reason: Qaida 42: «فتجب المبادرة إلى الرد» where held without consent or guaranteed - must he return at once.

right_for_or_against_self.reason: heardAfterDenial: 'after denying it, a right for the speaker is not heard; a right against him is' (Ibn al-Laḥḥām 54.f002); whether a claim/testimony is heard.

right_on_refuser_exacted.reason: Q110: «وإن كان حقا عليه وأمكن استيفاؤه منه استوفي» — outcome of refusal: the right owed is exacted from him.

right_to_own_disposal.question: wadi:validity

right_to_substitute.question: wadi:sabab

rukhsa_under_doubt.question: wadi:validity

second_receiver_liable.question: wadi:sabab

spread_follows_injury.question: wadi:sabab
spread_follows_injury.reason: Q128: output is that the spread (death from the injury) is guaranteed, i.e. whether ḍamān arises for it.

substitute.question: aspect:permitted

taker_from_usurper.reason: takerRecourse (Ibn Rajab 93 'رجع به على الغاصب'): whether the taker from a usurper has a right of recourse, unless he undertook the liability.

takes_only_by_special.reason: q119 first attached qāʿida «فإنه لا يأخذ إلا بالجهة الخاصة»: takesOnlyBySpecial - whether he takes by the special title alone, nothing from the general class's share (by which title / how much he takes).

trust_voidance.question: wadi:validity

unknown_order_judged_sequential.reason: Q108: what is unknown as simultaneous or sequential is judged sequential «لبعد التقارن» — a presumption establishing a fact.

unknown_owner.reason: recipient returns owner/publicInterest (Q20): to whom the right goes.

unqualified_sharika_halves.reason: q114 «إطلاق الشركة هل يتنزل على المناصفة أو هو مبهم»: sharikaHalves - whether unqualified 'partnership' wording is taken as half and half.

urf_specialises_general.reason: q121: urfGeneralCovers - 'whether the general wording, used without qualification or intention, covers the instance' under ʿurf.

vague_insha_valid.reason: Q105 inshāʾāt: «فلا يصح في مبهم» / «ويصح» — validity of the inshāʾ on a vague object.

wage_without_stipulation.question: wadi:sabab
wage_without_stipulation.reason: Q74: who is entitled to a wage for unstipulated work — a right (iwaḍ) arising from the work.

worship_ruled_from_start.reason: q116 attached class: worshipFromStart - whether a worship whose condition was attained within its time is ruled as having its conditions met from the beginning.
